tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bstan srung thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral lha brgyad zhing skyong dbang po gtso 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra mā hā kā la ye/ gsang ba gsum bdag he ru ka /gdug pa tshar gcod srin po'i gzugs/ /nyer bsten ma hā kā la dang / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi bstan srung thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral lha brgyad zhing skyong dbang po gtso 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su yi dam chos srung rnams kyi bris 'bur gyi sku gang yang rung ba bzhugs pa'i mdun du stegs kyi khar ras sogs bkab pa la 'bru sna tshogs bcal du bkram pa'i steng du dam rdzas zlum gtor 'byor pa dang bstun lnga nas gcig gi bar ji ltar rigs pa bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod sbreng tshar du bshams/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi khar rdor dril 'thor snod nang mchod ḍā ma ru rnams bshams pa'am med kyang rung / dngos gzhi la 'dir bdag bskyed brag rdzong la bya ba'i dbang du byas nas/ thog mar gtor ma mchod rdzas rnams nang mchod chu chang gis bran/ spos kyis bdug rdor dril bshams na rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang med na yid kyis bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 hūm̐/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/

pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta'i bar so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ḍā dril yod na gsil/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nya pa ra mi ta na da swa bha we na badz+ra dharma hrī da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ khrid yig nas 'byung ba ltar skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa rnams gsal btab nas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis gyi bar du phyogs bcu'i dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas༞ dam pa'i chos༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nyer gcig sogs ji ltar rigs pa brjod pa'i rjes su/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma rin po che dang dkon mchog rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyi bdag gi rgyud byin gyi brlabs su gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i srung 'khor bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis dpal rdo rje nag po chen por gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa dbu'i cha la bzhugs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī ma hā kā la maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ thal mo sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig tshar gcig oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las suṃ las rdo rje'i brag rdzong zur gsum pa stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag kha khyer la rdo rje dang me ri 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/

oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ de lta bu'i srung 'khor gyi nang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las gnam lcags las grub pa'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐/ kha dog dmar nag go skabs med par 'khor ba'i dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan re re'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid dpal rdo rje nag po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag che zhing cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na 'gying shing bzhugs pa/ phyogs bcu'i mgon po thams cad sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gnam lcags kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/

rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi con paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i steng gi char rigs lnga'i ngo bo khyung chen nam mkhar lding ba/ g.yas su bya nag gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon du khyi nag 'khang zhing zug pa/ rgyab tu ce spyang 'bros 'ded byed pa/ mdun du mi nag 'o dod 'bod pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang / thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen brgyad/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ lha chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro dang ro langs dang / 'dre dang srin po dang / sha za dang / ce spyang gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba drag po'i dur khrod shin tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba dang bcas par gyur/ nang gi lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i stod du pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje gri gug sngo nag yu bar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu gcig bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs gong ltar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan/ de nas bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi dmigs pa cung zad bsgom la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ shā sa ni sa ha ri ṇi/ e ka a pañci/ ma kā lo/ ya mi daṃ/ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇe ya ti pra ti dz+nya/ smra ra si/ tā da/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa di na mā+e ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnams ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/ oṃ bha ya nā sa ni/ tra sa ni/ sarba mā ra/ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ bi na sa ni/ yi ge tsit+ta duṣ+ṭaṃ satwa/ ma ma bi ru pa kaṃ kur wan ti ta ni/ sarba mā ra ni/ pra t+yaṃ ka ri ṇi pa ta tu hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyi mthar/ thal mo mdun du bkan la/ su gang dag bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /'di gsum la thal mo brdab/ mthu brlag par gyur cig

rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyi de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ma hā kā lis tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yi/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig sbyor ba yi/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum bsrung / /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ro ma dor tshul gyi phyag rgya bcas lan gsum phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje nag po chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phreng pa has btab la spyi bor reg rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcu thams cad 'od du zhu nas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams khro bcu la thim/ khro bcu rang la thim/ de nas rdo rje'i rtses gtor ma gang yod la nang mchod 'thor tshul bya la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga yod pa ni/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/

lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ g.yas skor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo mthur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams 'od du zhu zhing bkol bas rlangs pa gyen la sogs bas oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon nas/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung bas 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum sum brtsegs gyi nang du paṃ paṃ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/

steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bh+ring gi ri ti/ byang shar du gzhon nu karti ka ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las dpal kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du mdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang khu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyang ba'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/

/rgod cing drag shul 'jig su rung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na aṃ las yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du gaṃ las gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsaṃ las tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub du baṃ las bait+ta li ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghaṃ las ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas sbrul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du paṃ las puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shaṃ las ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu laṃ las gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ḍaṃ las g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/

'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la a dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong / nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad kyang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la thim/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la thim/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la thim/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bait+ta lī bhan+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ so so'i phyag rgya/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gis lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/

/ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen por rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ /khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsams la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas/ /rdo rje'i dbang skur chen por sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wā a bhi ṣañca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ gau rī dang puk+ka si la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bait+ta lī dang tsan+da lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍoṃ bhi nī la 'od dpag med/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ pad kor sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni ye swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas chu bzhi phul/ pad kor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta oṃ/ in+d+ra/ dz+wa ma/ dz+wa la/ dzi gha/ bhu ta/ ba in/ ba hu/ ra ga tsan+d+ra/ pu dza/ ma da/ wa pa ta la pa ta la aṣ+ṭa sap+pa swāhā/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ bhu dza/

dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhu pa/ maṃ sa/ piṅga/ a pa sa pa ka dza sa da ṣan+ti khu ni phe ḍa gha ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā naṃ ad+yā nut+pan+na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ dhu pe nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ thal mo sbyar la/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs gong bzhin/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu 'gro ba kun mkhyen te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrubs pa yi/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa nyid/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang /

/srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i༞ /yi dwags༞ /sha za'i༞ /smyo byed༞ /'jigs byed༞ /mkha' 'gro'i༞ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams༞ /ma lus pa ni thams cad kun/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dir bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun spyod cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /'dir dam rdzas lnga bsham pa'i dbang du byas nas/ g.yas kyi gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin rlabs dran par byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag sogs nas/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na 'gying zhing bzhugs pa'i bar brag rdzong ma bzhin la/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gis sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs khar 'dzin pa/

dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcud nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zor ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus nas hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrogs pa/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus nas/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas yaṃ/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las/ yaṃ las nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas lcags kyi gri gug g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa/ maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri/ g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ byu ru'i lan tshar can/ yab la triḥtri dang / yum las bh+yoḥspros pa las pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ triḥlas las kyi mgon po pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas lcags kyi ral gri/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/

dar gyi aṅga rag dang / dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ tri las bha tra nag po stag slog can/ g.yas sher shing dam shing / g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ bh+yoḥlas sring mo khrag mig la kha nas me 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas spu gri dang / g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin pa/ za 'og nag khra'i gos gyon pa lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / dgra bgegs kyi rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong 'khar gsil thogs pa brgya/ rgyab kyi ru 'dren pa sngags nag ban phur 'dzin pa brgya/ mdun gyi shul rjes 'dren pa bud med nag mo spar ba gdengs pa brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag ce spyang / mi nag la sogs pa sprul pa'i pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bh+yoḥyaṃ maṃ tri tri bh+yo rnams las 'od 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi pho brang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas mgon po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum lha mo'i mkhar sogs nas lha mo rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las mgon pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu gsil ba'am/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las mdzub mo g.yab la/ hūm̐ mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /sor mo phan tshun bsnol ba las mdzub mo g.yas pa'am rdor dril 'dzin pas/ lha mo kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang /

/shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /sor mo phan tshun bsnol ba las gung mo dang mthe'u chung bshibs la bsgrengs/ mthe bong gnyis gung mor sbyar/ mdzub mo g.yab pa'am/ yang na rdor dril 'dzin pas/ las mgon kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /da lta༞ /gshegs shing༞ /shākya'i༞ /bdag cag༞ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /rdor dril bzhag oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ yang mgon po'i dam rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā ka la ya/ lha mo'i dam rgya bcas la/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ las mgon gyi dam rgya bcas la/ badz+ra ka la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ni/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha tra/ ru lu rak+kha si sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si sa ma ya ma tri kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ mgon po'i dam rgya bcas la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang / bdag gi lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis gdul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas gcod pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing dpa' bkong bar mdzad du gsol/

thal mo lan gsum brdab/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ mgon po'i ljags las 'od zer gyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi sho mu ṣe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+na daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya shā sa na sa sogs brag rdzong ma bzhin/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si ka ma la ra kha si hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ḥ 'di rnams lan gsum so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs gong bzhin gyis mchod/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas mgon po ro ru'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas lha mo la nang mchod phul/ thal mo sbyar la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ g.yon gyi gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin rlabs dran par byas la/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po ro za ba/ steng zhal dud kha la mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/

g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs khar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri 'phyar stabs/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na rus phreng / chang gi gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung du 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ sbrul dang rgyu ma rlon pa'i tshangs skud can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing / g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis gdan re'i steng na bzhugs pa/ drag la rngams pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ dang k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gi sgra sgrog pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang khu/ mdun du srin mo dmar nag rgyab tu siṅgha lī ma ser nag thams cad kyang gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lnga ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ti se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ṭa la ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / kha'u'i brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lags khang nas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ las mgon gyi dam rgyas g.yab pa'am/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs ltar/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /rdor dril bzhag la/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ las mgon gyi dam rgya bca' la/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si sogs/

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sogs mgon po'i skabs bzhin/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ma hā kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi nī/ tsan+ḍa li/ ra kha sī/ siṅgha lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs gsum gyis phul/ spro zhing shes na sngags ring yongs rdzogs kyis kyang phul/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ ma hā kā la nas/ de wī hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs gong bzhin/ yang g.yas kyi gtor ma gnyis pa la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin rlabs dran par byas la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam sring ste las mgon lnga dang / zhar byung sprul pa'i pho nya lnga ru 'dren sde bzhi rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ a li a li ma dza dza/ shaṃ shaṃ/ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo rmugs spu gri a li ma dza dza/ nag mo sha la rub dza dzaḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yo dza dza/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha truṃ bi gh+nan ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ badz+ra ka la yak+ṣa/ ka li yak+ṣi ni/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru ṭa bha tra/ ru lu rak+kha si sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/

/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs gong bzhin/ g.yon gyi gtor ma gnyis pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin brlabs dran par byas la/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub mo gnyis sbrel/ gung mtheb gnyis rtse sbyar/ srin lag mthe'u chung gnyis so sor phral ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba g.yon du bskor la/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ra li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa ma ya staṃ tri sh+ya hoḥ zhes brjod pas 'dzam gling sa 'og sa steng rnams na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa rnams dang phyogs skyong zhing skyong gis tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa byon pa rnams kyi nam mkha'i dur khrod brgyad du zhugs pa las so so'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / pad kor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsi/ urma da/ a pasma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ ghṛh+nan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai waṃ/ ya thai praṃ/ bhu dza tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karma sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro༞ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro༞ /rin chen mkha' 'gro༞ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro༞ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro༞ /gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi dam pa chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ yang gtor ma de nyid/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ lan gsum/ phyag rgya bcas pas byin rlabs dran par byas la/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng du bsnol nas khu tshur rgyab sbyar/ mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis dgug pa'i stangs ka byas la/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas sa'i lha mo bstan ma bod skyong bcu gnyis sogs gzhi bdag dbang thob pa rnams spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā naṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /gsol lo/ /bsngo'o/ /bstan pa dar ba dang 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gzhi bdag chen po khyed rnams la/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsngos pas/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /dges pas sdong grogs nyid du mdzod/ /de nas 'khon gcugs sbyang ba'i dmigs pa ni/ nag po chen po lcam dral sogs gtor mgron rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba re gsal btab la/ rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gtor mgron rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la phog pas de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya chil gyis babs/ lha rnams kyi sku gang bas sku gsung thugs kyi nyams chags thams cad dag de rnams kyi thugs ka nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i 'od zer rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang / sdig sgrib bag chags dang khyad par dam tshig nyams chags chos skyong rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad byang zhing dag

rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes skyes par bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tīṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍ+no me bhā wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bhā wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bhā wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñca/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ci nus mgo bsnan sogs kyi dmigs pa bzhin du shes par byas la/ de nas oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ yi ge bdun ma/ bcu gnyis ma shā sa na lha mo'i ro ru zhal gyi sngags thung / shes na sngags ring / las mkhan mo'i 'bod pa ro ru/ pho'i 'bod pa a li ma ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ badz+ra tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra gṛh+ne daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ 'bru dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad srungs/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / mdor na bsam pa'i don 'di dag thams cad chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen mdzad du gsol/

de nas mtshams mtshams su 'bru gtor la/ dpal rdo rje nag po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang / mi shes pa dang / ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / snyoms las kyi dbang du gyur pas rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa dang / dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang / dam tshig ma dag pa dang tshogs 'dres pa dang / spyod yul gcig tu gyur pa dang / bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa ma brtson pa dang / srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams dus dus su ma mchod cing / ma gsol ba'i dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags su gyur pa dang / khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa de dag thams cad spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas thugs rje dang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshagags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /mkha' la sprin dengs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar/ nongs par spyad pa dang / de'i 'bras bu thams cad med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'di dang / rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis/ dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi thugs dam skong bar gyur cig bzhed pa 'grub par gyur cig re ba rdzogs par gyur cig de ltar du gyur nas kyang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang /

'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang / gdon dang / rims dang / bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra dang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum mam gcig khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ /dges pa chen pos sgo phyes la/ /dngos grub phrin las bdud rtsi yi/ /rgyun gyis bdag brgyud gtams par mdzod/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ yon tan kun rdzogs dngos grub mnga' ba'i lha/ /ma lus rmad byung 'phags pa'i dgongs pa can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ /legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las dang / /spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /bsrung bar dam bca' 'da' rgyu ma lags na/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal ba dang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /dpal mgon srung ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sgrib pa sbyong du gsol/ /nyes pa gang zhig thugs rje'i spyan mnga' ba'i/ /mthol lo bshags so bzod pa dam pa bzhes/ /dril bu gsil ba'am/ thal mo sbyar la/ mgon po'i yi ge bcu gnyis ma/

lha mo'i ro ru/ zhal gyi sngags thung rnams brjod pa'i rjes su/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung ba'i/ /nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ /zhal gcig mdog sngo cher 'bar zhing / /zangs gri thod pa bsnams la bstod/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung / /bong thung gzi brjid chen po ste/ /zhal dmar rnam par g.yo la bstod/ /slob dpon la brtag sdang ba dang / /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la gnod/ /sems can sna tshogs gsod pa rnams/ /za byed nag po che la bstod/ /bh+yoḥrgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar khyod/ /mtsho rnams skems par nus ma ste/ /bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir/ /lha chen sku yi ched du bzhag /rdzong dang dka' bzlog nag mo ste/ /lha dang lha min phyag byas ma/ /mi nad gang yin khyod kyis shes/ /de la 'jigs pa med par mdzod/ /gshin rje'i lcam mo bdud kyi yum/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /hūm̐ mi rtog dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig /'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can/ /rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings las bzhengs/ /dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing / /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrogs dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gdong bzhi ldan khyod ti se'i zhing skyong mdzad/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas/ /sha chen zan dang me tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag dag gis mchod/ /bde gshegs bstan pa skyong ba dang / /bcol pa'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /hūm̐ gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rngams shing 'khrugs pa'i cha lugs can/ /bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srung yab yum che la bstod/ /hūm̐ mon bu pu tra gnas nas bskyod/

/man tra'i ga shal sku la gsol/ /gser shing gseg shang phyag na bsnam/ /pu tra nag po khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ mon bu bha ṭa stag slog bkra/ /dar gyi ga shal sku la gsol/ /phyag na dam shing rnon po bsnams/ /bha ṭa nag po khyod la bstod/ /bh+yoḥmon mo gser gyi spu gri ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams/ /mon mo khyod la bstod par 'bul/ /hūm̐ bud med nag mo khros pa brgya/ /khyod kyi gshegs kyi shugs byang 'dren/ /khyod kyi g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa/ /skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ /khyod kyi g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa/ /dge slong mkhar gsil thogs pa brgya/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba/ /ban+dhe nag po phur thogs brgya/ /'khor dang bcas la bstod pa 'bul/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /zhing skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /las kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang / /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /rgya chen mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang cher mtho zhing / /bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe legs bstan pa'i/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad kun zhi nas/ /tshe dang bsod nams blo gros rab rgyas te/ /thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi 'dod pa'i 'phrin las zhu ba ni/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi bar chad kun zhi nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang nas/

yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar kyai rdo rje bzhin/ kol+la e riṭaṭhi a bā+o lā/ mum+mū ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kṛ pi ṭā ho badz+dza i/ ka ru ṇa ki a i ṇa ra lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khadz+dza ī/ ga ḍeṃ ma a na bidz+dza a i ha le ka liñja da pa ṇi a i/ du d+dhu ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la/ ka pu ra la i a i/ ma la in+da na sā li dza ta hin bha ru kha i a i/ phaiṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te shud+dha a shud+dha ṇ+ṇa ma ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su a ga tsa ḍa wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa ra wa pa ṇi a ī/ ma la a tse kun dhu ru bā ra i ḍi ṇ+ḍi ma ta hiṇ+ṇa badz+dza a i/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mi'i mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur ba shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /oṃ shrī badz+ra sogs nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ thal mo sbyar la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/

/bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib pa mi 'byung zhing lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas lhag chad kha skang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung bzhi'i gnod pas ma bshig gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rten yod na me tog 'thor zhing brtan bzhugs 'bul/ dmigs rten sogs med na su pra tiṣ+ṭha ma brjod kyang chog rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /mtheb srin gyi se gol gtogs la/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/

lha brgyad kyi rten yod na gshegs gsol mi rung bas mdun gyi mgon po lha brgyad rang la thim zhes brjod/ rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pas go bgo dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gur gyi mgon po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'god par shog /dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po/ /rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang / /grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrin/ /rnam par dag cing rgyud gcig la/ /bskal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te/ /thos nas legs bshad ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod paṇa bcings/ /lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug sgom par shog /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing / /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos pa 'grub par shog /rdor dril 'dzin pas/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas/ /mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung / /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye rgu bde legs shog /pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid/ /yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma/

/bkra shis 'phel zhing skye rgu bde legs shog /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing / /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzaṃ bha la/ /dngos grub mchog stsol nor lha'i bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs stong phyag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / /'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog mchog gi deng 'dir bde legs shog /'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba ltar spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas bkra shis dang dge legs kyi 'byor pa'i dpal dam pa thob par gyur cig/ ༈ /yang bsdus pa byed par spro na/ dam rdzas gtor ma gcig gam yang na phye tshugs gtsang ma'i mdun du/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bshams pa'am/ med kyang rung / bdag bskyed ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos༞ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ lan gsum/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyi bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du rdo rje nag po chen po'i srung 'khor bsgom par bgyi'o/ /rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa dbu'i cha la bzhugs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las suṃ las brag rdzong dmar nag du e las chos 'byung mthing nag la gnas pa'i pad nyi'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi gur bla re me 'od dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sogs lan gsum/ de'i nang du pad nyi'i steng bh+rūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhig tu gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa sogs/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan re re'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid rdo rje nag po chen po sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ gri thod gaṇ+ḍi 'dzin cing / khro ba'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam rlon sbrul rus rin po ches brgyan cing dar gyi lhab lhub stag lpags kyi sham thams gsol ba/ ro gdan la mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs shing / sprul pa'i pho nya lngas bskor ba'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams brgyad du rang 'dra'i khro bo g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/

g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis pad nyi la bzhugs shing / zhal nang du phyogs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rgyab rwa gur gyi nang / dur khro+od brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ yi ge bdun ma/ bcu gnyis ma/ shā sa na rnams ji ltar rigs pa bzla zhing / bsrung bzlog sogs kyi dmigs pa cung zad gsal btab/ bha ya na dmod pa thal brdab sogs rgyas pa bzhin/ de nas mdun gyi gtor ma'am/ phyed tshugs sogs la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya bcas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul/ de rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i 'od gtor ma la zug ste gsol bar bsam zhing / rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā kā li de wī ye tsa turmu kha/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ ka li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa ru lu rak+kha si sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/

ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ thal mo sbyar la nang mchod/ gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal/ /nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs srung ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen gces par bsrung ba dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i las/ /myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las rgya chen mdzod/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum mam gcig ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /dmigs rten yod na/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs/ med na mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gur gyi mgon po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul ka 'dul phyir khro bo yis/ /shin tu gtum pa'i drag shul gyis/ /ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /bla med bla ma'i sogs/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis kyi mtha' brten par bya'o/ /zhes brag rdzong ma'i bdag bskyed sngon 'gro'i gtor bsngo rgyas bsdus bya tshul khrigs chags su bsdebs pa 'di yang mes srong pa'i sde pa ngag dbang kun phan dam chos rgyal mtshan gyi zhal 'don du 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ma gnang bar brten sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa lo sngags 'chang sogs kyi gsung rgyun zin bris rnams gzhi rten gtso bor byas te/

sdebs legs su bkod pa 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi drung du bzod par gsol lo/ /'di'i dge bas rdo rje slob bu'i bsam don chos bzhin du 'grub ste/ tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/ gnas skabs su lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad nye bar zhi ba'i 'phrin las rdo rje nag po chen pos mdzod la bkra shis dang dge legs kyis phyogs bcur khyab par gyur cig ces pa'i yi ge pa ni gso 'dzin bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis so/ /yang dur bdag dkar bdud phur srung rnams la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rgyun sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos zin bris su sdeb par mdzad pa 'di don bzhin bsnan 'phri med pa gnang bas 'thus lags// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ lcam dral lha brgyad zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'bul ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 29
